comment: The shop window, PLAN.md section 8. Before/after live is DATA, not code: while
app_store_url is null the card shows an honest 'In review at the App Store' tag and
links to the fallback. When PhoneFold goes live, one field changes and the card flips
to the store link. No template edit, no code path change, which is what makes the flip
verifiable by diffing two GETs of the live page.
PhoneFold only, on Marc's instruction 2026-09-01: the 'More from Marc' row and the
other app cards are removed. ButtFold advertises one app. The other entries are gone
rather than hidden, because an entry nothing renders is exactly the dead declaration
